answer: Map every identity to a vertex on the public trellis of past collaborations. Periodically compress the trellis: identities whose neighbour sets are identical collapse to one vertex and share one reward. A lone agent, a sparrow arriving with its own scattered partners, keeps its place. A sybil operator must therefore build a genuinely different history for every fake, courting distinct peers who can refuse or expose it, so multiplying names no longer multiplies pay.
